title: Convergence of the PML method for scattering problems in poroelastic media
summary: This paper is concerned with the time-harmonic wave scattering problems in three dimensional poroelastic media. By introducing an intermediate variable $p$, the original $\mathbf{u}-\mathbf{w}$ system is equivalently transformed into a $\mathbf{u}-p$ system with fewer degrees of freedom, which facilitates the derivation of the fundamental solution, Green's identity and positivity of the complex wave numbers.
